title: Grateful Dead Live at Mammoth Gardens on 1970-04-24
lineage: AUD > MR > Reel > DAT > Cool Edit Pro > CDR > SHN

ai_review.summary: Recording suffers from poor sound quality and pitch issues, but features a noteworthy Dark Star.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers flag serious audio problems – sub‑par fidelity, a slower‑than‑normal pitch, tracking flaws and false starts – making the tape hard to recommend for casual listeners.  The only bright spot is the Dark Star, which one reviewer describes as a strong performance worth hearing despite the technical shortcomings.

ai_rating.rationale: Limited data (only two reviews) with conflicting views: recording quality is judged poor to fair, while the show gets a modest boost from a praised Dark Star.  Weighted average yields a low‑mid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note sub‑par sound, slower pitch than comparable shows, tracking flaws (false start, broken string), and overall muddy or unclear mix.  Not disastrous but not suitable for casual listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Limited commentary; the show is described as slower‑paced with some tracking glitches, but Dark Star stands out as a high point.
